name: Project Coordinator
description: Each project in the Projects tab is its own conversation: click the project to talk to its coordinator, and the threads it starts nest under the project with their live status. An Overview beside the conversation groups those threads by state, and agents share a short project memory.

actions.title: Open project coordinator
actions.description: Open this project's coordinator thread, starting one if it has none.

actions.title: Open project conversation
actions.description: Open this project's conversation from the Projects tab, starting it the first time.

actions.title: New project
actions.description: Start a project's conversation, or bring back its archived one, from the top of the Projects tab.

actions.title: Read the coordinator guide
actions.description: The coordinator's playbook: how to scope the goal, delegate workers through T3, review their results and assemble them. Read it at the start of a coordinator conversation, and again whenever you need it.

actions.title: Read project memory
actions.description: Read your project's shared notes: decisions, conventions and context every worker should know. Returns {notes: [{id, text, threadId, createdAt}]}, oldest first. Include the relevant notes when you brief a worker.

actions.title: Add to project memory
actions.description: Add one durable note to your project's shared memory. Input: {text} (up to 1000 characters). Record decisions and conventions, not progress. Reuse the operationId when retrying.

actions.title: Ask another project
actions.description: From a project's main conversation, send work or a question to another project's coordinator instead of starting a worker there. Input: {projectId, message} (up to 4000 characters; projectId from t3_project_list). If the person has to add the project first, T3 shows them a card and the message goes out when they approve. Then end your turn: the reply arrives in this conversation. Each project can ask another 10 times an hour. Reuse the operationId when retrying.

actions.title: Reply to a project
actions.description: Answer a message another project's coordinator sent this conversation. Input: {handoffId, message}, with the handoffId from that message. It goes to the conversation that asked, once per ask. Reuse the operationId when retrying.

actions.title: Project access answered
actions.description: Runs when a person answers T3's card asking to add a project.

nativeTrees.title: Projects
nativeTrees.description: Projects you talk to: each one is a conversation, with the threads it started nested under it.
nativeTrees.emptyText: Each project here is one conversation that plans the work and hands it to threads nested under it.
